judge_cost_audit.basis: immutable semantic Judge run manifest, summary, pair call receipts, and normalized provider usage metadata
judge_cost_audit.evaluation_boundary: This artifact only audits frozen external Judge billing receipts. It must never be imported by method prompts, binding, routing, execution, W, D, publication, or Judge semantic decisions.
judge_cost_audit.reason: All successful, failed, retried, and unpriced Judge calls are retained. A missing provider usage record is reported as an unpriced billable call, never estimated as an exact cost and never treated as a semantic failure.
